source.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one EXTREMELY SIMPLE CLASSIC 8-BIT CAT SPRITE matching the attached reference's graphic simplicity very closely. This is a tiny retro game sprite, NOT an illustration and NOT a pixelated painting. Orange four-legged cat with a front-facing square head, body extending sideways, short legs, upright curled tail, tiny two black SQUARE eyes, a white rectangular muzzle/chest, and a single red collar stripe. Follow the reference proportions and pose. Maximum 8 flat solid colors. Very thick dark blocky outline. Every shape made of large perfectly aligned square pixel blocks as if the entire cat were only 18 pixels wide by 14 pixels tall and then enlarged with nearest-neighbor. No diagonally rotated pixels, no curves, no fur strands, no whiskers, no cheek blush, no eye highlights, no realistic anatomy, no expressive anime eyes, no bell, no shading gradients, no texture, no glow, no lighting. Cat centered on a completely flat warm cream #fffbea background. Empty background only, absolutely no scenery, ground, grass, path, buildings, shadows or other objects. Landscape3:2canvas. Cat around55 percent of imageheight, fullyvisiblewithcomfortableemptyspaceallaround. No text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve the naive simple old-game character appeal of the reference, do not embellish.
